# BEFORE REPORTING:
If reporting a security vulnerability, please go [here](https://github.com/etangaming123/etanbot/security).

Check if the bot is online. This can be done with /etanbot-ping, as etan bot's online status is hidden. If the /etanbot-ping command does not work, the bot is offline, and this bug should not be reported. 
If the command does work, you may report this bug.

# Describe the bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.
## Example
✅Good:
etan bot's /etanbot-clean-link" command is stuck on infinite thinking when I input "https://example.com?sid=asdfafsdafdsfads
❌Bad:
etan bot is broken

## Write the bug description below.

# To Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior.

## Example
✅Good:
1. Use /etanbot-create-profile command
2. Check if command says profile created
3. Use /etanbot-profile on myself
4. It doesn't show my profile!
❌Bad:
1. Use command
2. Command broken.

## Write the steps below.

# Expected behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Example
✅Good: etan bot should have responded with x, but it responded with y.
❌Bad: it did not give me answer

# Screenshots
